title: Outcome of a Triple Inner Branched Aortic Arch Stentgraft. A Prospective, Multicenter Registry.
official: Outcome of a Triple Inner Branched Aortic Arch Stentgraft. A Prospective, Multicenter Registry.
summary: Outcome of a triple inner branched aortic arch stentgraft. A prospective, mulitcenter registry.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years or older
* Presence of Aortic arch pathology
* Treatment planned with triple inner branch from Terumo Aortic
* Availability of the patients during the follow up period
* Informing patients about the study and providing written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Women of childbearing age
* Patients under 18 years
